title: Visible Human head CT (demo, brain window only)
summary: Real CT of a cadaveric head from the NLM Visible Human Project, recovered from the NeuroAxis atlas grid into physical millimetres. Brain window only; no segmentation bundled.
source: NLM Visible Human Project — Additional Head Images CT
credit: Courtesy of the U.S. National Library of Medicine
attribution: Courtesy of the U.S. National Library of Medicine. Historical CT data; not NLM’s most current or most accurate dataset. NLM does not endorse NeuroAxis.

intensity.note: Source was stored pre-windowed to -20..100 HU (8-bit). Values outside that range are clipped, so bone/subdural/wide windows cannot show real detail. Rebuild from the original DICOM (scripts/ct-anatomy/build_case.py) for a fully calibrated volume.

limitations: Cadaveric specimen: grey/white contrast and ventricular size differ from a living patient.
Resampled twice (atlas grid then back to mm); fine detail below ~1.5 mm is lost.
No TotalSegmentator labels are bundled — run build_case.py on the source DICOM to add them.
axes: LPS: +x patient left, +y posterior, +z superior; volume.bin is x-fastest
